title: Entity Type Definition
description: A non-battle entity type (friendly NPC / quest actor): id, label, display name and overworld rendering. Battle-capable and shared-overworld-art types live in screens/enemy_types/. The editor and the entity-id compiler both read these; entity ids are generated from the union of both directories.

id.description: Unique type id (lowercase, underscores). Maps to ENTITY_ID_<ID>.

kind.description: npc = friendly actor; item = pickup/prop actor.

sprite_kind.description: How this type renders when it has no shared overworld art.
